content:
Maria: Quick weekend poll — mini roadtrip to the coast (waves + tacos) or the Sunday farmers market + picnic? :beach_umbrella: :tomato:
Sam K.: Coast sounds perfect. I can drive if we leave ~9am.
Kevin R.: Farmers market for me — need to restock veggies. Could meet for the picnic after 11:30.
Olivia: If coast, can we stop for coffee en route? :coffee:
Jude: I'm torn. Coast -> i'll bring a blanket + speakers. Market -> i'll bring sourdough.
Lily: vote: :one: coast :two: market
Maria: Okay — react with :one: for coast, :two: for market. I'll tally at 5pm.
Sam K.: :one:
Kevin R.: :two:
Olivia: :one: (coffee stop mandatory)
Jude: :one:
Lily: :two:
WeekendBot: Poll closed automatically at 17:00 — Results: coast 3, market 2.
Maria: Coast wins! Plan: meet at the office lobby at 8:45, roll out by 9:00. Carpool list so far: Sam K., Olivia, Jude, Maria. Kevin R. — can you join us at the pier for the picnic at ~11:30? @Kevin R.
Kevin R.: Yep, I'll meet at the pier at 11:30. Bringing picnic blanket and lemonade.
Maria: Sweet. I'll DM driving directions and parking tips. Anyone allergic to shellfish or anything we should avoid for picnic food?
Lily: i'm allergic to shellfish, thanks for checking.
Maria: Noted. See y'all Sunday :car: :ocean:
